name: chuck
why: A concurrent, strongly timed audio programming language where code runs sound on the fly; a classic instrument-like door into live coding.

brief.what_it_is: ChucK is a programming language for real-time sound synthesis and music creation. You write code that runs sound live, and the homepage says it supports MIDI, OpenSoundControl, HID devices, and multi-channel audio. Its output is audio, and the homepage describes it as used for building synthesis and analysis programs and real-time interactive music. It is open source and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. The homepage lists the latest version as 1.5.5.8 (chai).
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage presents it as a tool for composers, researchers, and performers who want a powerful programming tool for building and experimenting with complex audio synthesis and analysis programs, and real-time interactive music, while still being fun and easy to learn.
brief.how_it_works: The homepage describes a time-based, concurrent programming model that it calls strongly-timed, along with dynamic control rates and the ability to add and modify code on the fly. It does not explain the internals further.
brief.install_notes: The homepage gives no install steps, hardware requirements, or first-run instructions. It only says ChucK is freely available on macOS, Windows, and Linux. The brew metadata lists a single executable named chuck. A 'Welcome to ChucK!' section appears on the page, but its content was not shown in the fetched text.
brief.standout: Strongly-timed concurrency combined with changing code while sound is playing is the core pitch, which sets it apart from most text-based audio tools. The surrounding ecosystem is also broad: ChuGL for graphics, WebChucK for browsers, ChuMP as a package manager, SmucK for symbolic music, ChAI for AI, plus integrations with Unity, TouchDesigner, Unreal, Pure Data, and Max/MSP.
brief.status: Maintained, judging by the homepage. It shows 'ChucK Team | 2003 => now', names latest version 1.5.5.8 (chai), and lists several active ecosystem projects. The homepage gives no release date or commit date, so I could not confirm recency beyond that.
brief.caveats: Several items in the ecosystem are marked as early or alpha: ChuGL is 'alpha', Chunreal is 'early in development', and ChucK~ for Pure Data and Max/MSP is 'early in development'. The homepage says only 'open-source' and does not name a license. I read only the homepage and did not follow any docs links, so install details, the command-line interface, and language reference are not covered here.
quotes: ChucK is a programming language for real-time sound synthesis and music creation.
a unique time-based, concurrent programming model that is precise and expressive (we call this strongly-timed)
It's fun, easy to learn, and offers composers, researchers, and performers a powerful programming tool
